headline: SpecCompact reports faster agent context compaction through parallel semantic verification
summary: A 4 November arXiv preprint introduces SpecCompact, which fine-tunes a small drafter to generate six context-summary slots in parallel and uses a target model to verify and repair proposed lines. The authors report 2.04–5.63× compaction-latency speedups over Hermes-style summarization across AppWorld and τ³ with Gemma4-31B-IT and Qwen3.5-122B-A10B. A separate Hermes/Gemma4 deployment study reports an 8.68× median paired speedup across three author-designed scenarios. These are paper-reported measurements. The paper says the method does not provide a consistent accuracy advantage; task-performance results vary by model and benchmark, and the full task evaluation did not use all system optimizations.
